summary: Frontend-only verification of Firebase cloud sync on the LIVE GitHub Pages production deployment (https://raceryug-trading.github.io/tradingbull/). Validated landing page + brand + 4 stat cards + market ticker, WhatsApp floating button number, cloud-badge / cloud-sync-indicator (proving firebaseEnabled=true in the deployed bundle), real Firestore student login (test1/test123) landing on /#/modules with modules rendered, admin invalid-credential failure path via Firebase Auth, and protected-route redirects for /#/modules and /#/admin. No test data was written to Firestore. All 8 requested checks passed.

issues: Browser tab title on the live deployment is still the default 'Emergent | Fullstack App' instead of 'Trading Bulls Academy' — cosmetic branding/SEO miss in public/index.html

action_items: Optional (cosmetic): set <title> in /app/frontend/public/index.html to 'Trading Bulls Academy — Master the Markets' and redeploy; currently shows 'Emergent | Fullstack App'.

Optional (robustness): one transient Firestore WebChannel 'Listen' transport error / [code=unavailable] was logged on first load from the test container network; the app degraded gracefully (cloudFetchStudent fallback still authenticated the student). Consider surfacing a small 'reconnecting' state instead of a raw console error.
critical_code_review_comments: Login.jsx correctly falls back to cloudFetchStudent when the local snapshot has not hydrated — verified working on the live build (student login succeeded ~1s after page load).
Failed admin login does not write ta_session to localStorage (verified null) — no partial-auth leak.

Student passwords are compared client-side against a publicly-readable Firestore document (cloudFetchStudent + cloudUser.password === password). This is a security design weakness, not a bug: any visitor can read student credentials via public Firestore reads. Recommend moving student auth to Firebase Auth accounts or Cloud Functions before wider rollout.
seed_data_creation: None — no writes made to production Firestore, as instructed.
test_credentials: Student test1/test123 exists in production Firestore and works. Real admin password intentionally NOT used; only test@fake.com/wrong tested (correctly rejected).
context_for_next_testing_agent: LIVE base URL https://raceryug-trading.github.io/tradingbull/ with HashRouter (#/login, #/modules, #/admin). firebaseEnabled=true on the deployed bundle: cloud-badge in header + cloud-sync-indicator on /#/login both render, and admin mode switches the username field to email type with placeholder admin@yourdomain.com. Firestore student test1/test123 is present in production. The console '400' error seen during admin login is the expected Firebase Auth identitytoolkit response for invalid credentials — NOT a config error (no auth/unauthorized-domain, no api-key-not-valid, no permission-denied observed). Admin console (/#/admin) was not exercised because real admin credentials were off-limits; the admin cloud pill remains untested.
rca_of_the_issue: No defects found. Firebase config is correctly baked into the production bundle, authorized domain works (auth requests reach identitytoolkit and return a proper invalid-credentials error rather than a domain rejection), and Firestore public reads succeed (modules/announcements and student lookup).
